objectives.en: Count in fives from five to sixty without help.
objectives.yo: Kà ní márùn-ún márùn-ún láti márùn-ún dé ọgọ́ta láìsí ìrànlọ́wọ́.
objectives.pcm: Count for five five from five reach sixty without help.

objectives.en: Say the next number when you hear a number from the fives.
objectives.yo: Sọ nọ́ńbà tó kàn nígbà tí o bá gbọ́ nọ́ńbà kan nínú àwọn márùn-ún márùn-ún.
objectives.pcm: Talk the next number when you hear one number from the five five.

curriculum.objective: Apply counting to local counting in groups of fives (yams, oranges, onions), market days
curriculum.note: NERDC frames this as local market counting, alongside sevens and sixties, which have no plan yet.

say.en: Mama Ngozi sells oranges at the market. She puts five oranges in every heap.
say.yo: Mama Ngozi ń ta ọsàn ní ọjà. Ó máa ń fi ọsàn márùn-ún sí òkìtì kọ̀ọ̀kan.
say.pcm: Mama Ngozi dey sell orange for market. She dey put five orange for every heap.

say.en: Today we count her oranges, heap by heap.
say.yo: Lónìí a ó ka àwọn ọsàn rẹ̀, òkìtì kọ̀ọ̀kan.
say.pcm: Today we go count her orange, heap by heap.

say.en: One heap has five oranges. How many oranges are in two heaps?
say.yo: Òkìtì kan ní ọsàn márùn-ún. Ọsàn mélòó ni ó wà ní òkìtì méjì?
say.pcm: One heap get five orange. How many orange dey inside two heaps?

say.en: Three heaps. Five, ten, fifteen. Every heap adds five more.
say.yo: Òkìtì mẹ́ta. Márùn-ún, mẹ́wàá, mẹ́ẹ̀dógún. Fi márùn-ún kún un.
say.pcm: Three heaps. Five, ten, fifteen. Every heap add five more.

say.en: Say these with me: five, ten, fifteen, twenty.
say.yo: Sọ pẹ̀lú mi: márùn-ún, mẹ́wàá, mẹ́ẹ̀dógún, ogún.
say.pcm: Now talk the first four with me: five ten fifteen twenty.

say.en: Let us try a smaller one. Mama has three heaps, five oranges in each. How many oranges?
say.yo: Jẹ́ ká gbìyànjú èyí tó kéré. Mama ní òkìtì mẹ́ta, ọsàn márùn-ún nínú kọ̀ọ̀kan. Ọsàn mélòó ni?
say.pcm: Make we try smaller one. Mama get three heaps, five orange inside each. How many orange?

say.en: Now you. Mama has six heaps, five oranges in each. How many oranges?
say.yo: Ìwọ náà báyìí. Mama ní òkìtì mẹ́fà, ọsàn márùn-ún nínú kọ̀ọ̀kan. Ọsàn mélòó ni?
say.pcm: Na your turn. Mama get six heaps, five orange inside each. How many orange?

say.en: Count the heaps one by one. Five, ten, fifteen. Then try again.
say.yo: Ka àwọn òkìtì ní ọ̀kọ̀ọ̀kan. Márùn-ún, mẹ́wàá, mẹ́ẹ̀dógún. Lẹ́yìn náà tún gbìyànjú.
say.pcm: Count the heaps one by one. Five, ten, fifteen. Then try again.

say.en: Let us see what you remember. Eight heaps of yams, five yams in each. How many yams?
say.yo: Jẹ́ ká wo ohun tí o rántí. Òkìtì ẹ̀gbọ́ mẹ́jọ, ẹ̀gbọ́ márùn-ún nínú kọ̀ọ̀kan. Mélòó ni?
say.pcm: Make we see wetin you remember. Eight heaps of yam, five yam inside each. How many yam?

say.en: Very good today! Tomorrow we count days and weeks.
say.yo: Ó dára púpọ̀ lónìí! Ní ọ̀la a ó ka ọjọ́ àti ọ̀sẹ̀.
say.pcm: Very good today! Tomorrow we go count days and weeks.
